what_happened: Scene: layout 10, grey espresso machine CoffeeMachine051 (low portafilter, steam wand, dial; start button high on the upper-left front), tall orange mug_4 on the upper shelf. Stage 0: grasp 104/116, carried to the machine by ~300. 300-480 the tall mug was pushed in under the low portafilter; its rim met the portafilter and the mug was held tilted (up to 30 deg) against it for ~180 steps. Released 495 at 0.0466 m; it rocked back upright (500-528) and settled just under the group head, slightly towards the robot, 0.0429 m from the pour site (2.9 mm outside the 4 cm tolerance), and stayed there to the end (0.0429). Stage 1: the policy never touched the machine. After the release it backed away (560-640, wrist looks at the machine front and then the whole counter) and from ~800 to 1200 hovered 40-60 cm away, looking at the machine.
causal_chain: tall mug pushed under a low portafilter, held tilted against it 300-480 -> released 495, settles upright just in front of the spout at 0.043 m (3 mm outside tolerance) -> stage 0 never counts -> policy never goes to the button (no machine contact at all) -> timeout
official_criterion_notes: Near miss against the official 4 cm: the mug ends 0.0429 m from the pour site. In the agent and wrist views it stands under the group head, a little towards the front; a human would very likely call it 'under the dispenser'. Even so, the episode would not have succeeded, because the button was never attempted.
uncertain_about: Whether the policy skipped the button because the placement looked wrong to it or for another reason; there is no button attempt to look at.
